description.narrative:
The over-arching objective of the Project is to modernize Turkmenistan’s infrastructure for mobile com¬munication, internet bandwidth, telecommunication network and enhanced radio spectrum in order to provide the country’s population with state-of-the-art digital services and to contribute to the economic growth of the country through developing the Turkmenistan telecommunication system.
It includes installing technologies enablers into the network operators to offer users a wider range of more advanced services while achieving greater network capacity through improved spectral efficiency.
